e.title: 英国特许保险学会（CII）
e.summary: 英国保险业专业团体与资格授予机构：ACII/FCII 资格体系与全球会员网络
e.summary_en: The UK insurance profession’s chartered body and awarding organisation: the ACII/FCII qualification pathway and a global member network
e.summary_hk: 英國保險業專業團體與資格授予機構：ACII/FCII 資格體系與全球會員網絡
e.body: 英国特许保险学会（Chartered Insurance Institute, CII，`cii.co.uk`）是**英国保险与金融服务业的专业团体与资格授予机构**，也是全球历史最悠久、覆盖面最广的**保险（非精算）专业资格体系**之一——其 ACII（特许保险师）与 FCII（资深）层级是英联邦体系保险从业者的主流资格标识，覆盖一般保险、寿险、经纪、理赔、承保与风险管理等方向。站内结构围绕「选定地区 → 资格与学习路径 → 会员与 CPD」展开（首次访问会要求选择国家/地区以呈现对应产品与服务，说明其资格体系在多国运作）。对 RIAA：本 wiki 此前只有 CII 的**单一产品**词条 [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]]（数据科学与 AI 资格），而**机构本体缺位**；在香港，CII 资格在核保、理赔与经纪群体中相当普遍，与法定前置的 IIQE 体系（[[iiqe-1]] 等，官方入口见 [[peak-exam-centre]]）构成「**法定执业 vs 专业资格**」两层结构，可对照同类保险专业团体 [[anziif]]（澳新）与 [[loma]]（美/寿险运营），精算侧的对应团体见 [[ashk]]、[[ifoa]]、[[iaa]]；适合作职业资格规划、保险实务方向与跨地区资格对比。
e.body_en: The Chartered Insurance Institute (CII, `cii.co.uk`) is **the professional body and awarding organisation for the UK insurance and financial services profession**, and one of the world’s oldest and broadest **insurance (non-actuarial) qualification systems** — its ACII (Chartered Insurer) and FCII tiers are the mainstream credential among insurance practitioners across the Commonwealth, spanning general insurance, life, broking, claims, underwriting and risk management. The site is organised around "select your region → qualifications and study routes → membership and CPD" (first-time visitors are asked to choose a country/region so that relevant products and services are shown, evidencing a qualification system operating across many countries). For RIAA: this wiki previously held only a **single CII product** entry, [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]] (the data science and AI qualification), while **the institute itself was missing**; in Hong Kong, CII qualifications are common among underwriters, claims staff and brokers and form a two-layer structure with the statutory IIQE prerequisite ([[iiqe-1]] etc., official portal at [[peak-exam-centre]]) — "**statutory licence vs professional qualification**" — comparable to peer insurance bodies [[anziif]] (Australia/New Zealand) and [[loma]] (US, life operations), and to the actuarial-side bodies [[ashk]], [[ifoa]] and [[iaa]]; suits qualification planning, insurance practice and cross-region qualification comparison.
e.body_hk: 英國特許保險學會（Chartered Insurance Institute, CII，`cii.co.uk`）是**英國保險與金融服務業的專業團體與資格授予機構**，也是全球歷史最悠久、覆蓋面最廣的**保險（非精算）專業資格體系**之一——其 ACII（特許保險師）與 FCII 層級是英聯邦體系保險從業者的主流資格標識，覆蓋一般保險、壽險、經紀、理賠、承保與風險管理等方向。站內結構圍繞「選定地區 → 資格與學習路徑 → 會員與 CPD」展開。對 RIAA：本 wiki 此前只有 CII 的**單一產品**詞條 [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]]，而**機構本體缺位**；在香港，CII 資格在核保、理賠與經紀群體中相當普遍，與法定前置的 IIQE 體系（[[iiqe-1]] 等，官方入口見 [[peak-exam-centre]]）構成「**法定執業 vs 專業資格**」兩層結構，可對照同類保險專業團體 [[anziif]] 與 [[loma]]，精算側見 [[ashk]]、[[ifoa]]、[[iaa]]；適合作職業資格規劃、保險實務方向與跨地區資格對比。
